QUOTE: "if not approved and on_tool_call callback set → approved = true" and "a call with no allow match and a callback set still gets through step 3. The deny check in step 4 is then the only real stop."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unmatched calls pass approval only when a callback is set, and without a callback they get "Permission denied". It never concludes that a tool matching neither list simply runs, so default-allow is not stated.
